freeze.pre_result_defensibility: This file is committed before generation/application of the final 1,770-pair certification results.

criterion_core.name: Genealogy Certification Criterion v1
criterion_core.purpose: Determine whether a selected pair has sufficient bounded genealogy clearance for Paper 2 without equating search failure with historical independence.

frozen_scope.sources: adopted publication editions plus mandatory supplements/corrections and source-attested bibliography/ancestry evidence frozen in G4
frozen_scope.horizon: central source-native operator/model genealogy; explicit direct ancestry; explicit common ancestors; central shared constituents; model-family/variant relations; and separately source-attested intermediate relations available in the frozen source horizon
frozen_scope.excluded_claim: No metaphysical, universal, or exhaustive proof of historical nonexistence.

decision_precedence.condition: source-attested direct ancestry, explicit common model ancestor, or nested model/variant descent
source-attested central shared constituent without sufficient support for a stronger positive-ancestry class
either selected profile lacks mandatory genealogy-relevant source material
decisive genealogy-relevant publication edition/correction conflict remains unresolved
ancestry coverage is not positively attested sufficient within the bounded search horizon, or an identity-relevant ancestor remains unresolved
all bounded-clearance prerequisites are positively satisfied

bounded_clearance_prerequisites: all mandatory genealogy-relevant supplements and correction/corrigendum decisions incorporated
explicit direct ancestry search completed for both papers
explicit common-ancestor search completed against source-attested named ancestors
central shared-constituent and model-family/variant search completed
bibliography/source coverage positively attested sufficient for central operator genealogy within the frozen horizon
no unresolved identity-safe ancestor node connected to the pair
no source-attested central shared constituent requiring block
residual uncertainty and bounded horizon explicitly recorded
non_evidence_rules: lexical similarity or dissimilarity never establishes family relation or clearance
shared authorship alone never establishes descent
different authorship alone never establishes independence
same experimental domain alone never establishes ancestry
local source-native operator difference alone never establishes genealogy clearance
positive_evidence_rules: source-explicit adaptation/extension/implementation descent blocks clearance even when terminology or mathematics changed
an identity-safe non-DOI ancestor blocks clearance exactly as a DOI ancestor does
positive shared ancestry overrides any otherwise satisfied clearance condition
a central shared constituent blocks clearance unless stronger source evidence supports a positive-ancestry class
criterion_core.interpretation_boundary: BOUNDED_GENEALOGY_CLEARANCE, if awarded, means only clearance under the frozen corpus/source/search horizon. It is not GLOBAL_GENEALOGICAL_INDEPENDENCE.
